text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria, I saw Verxina
surrounded by an enormous amount of snacks and meat buns.
choice_data_list: What's with all those sweets and meat buns?
What's with all those sweets and meat buns?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: This? My younger sisters gave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Thank you, Vivlos.
I wonder what's inside?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "It's a treat! Luqaimat—fried Dubai doughnuts~♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mecchan-senpai looked up the recipe and we made them together♪
There's plenty, so eat up, eat up~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what am I doing...?
So many of these...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cheval.
That smell... could it be a meat bun?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Big sister...
...Um, I made too much during our nutrition practical...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now... I'm trying to lose weight...
Then again, throwing it out would be a terrible waste...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm starving after training.
Would you mind if I had that?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's why
I'm eating this right now.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Both turned out delicious,
I simply can't stop eating, you know? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina proudly boasts about it with a delighted look.
Though, combining sweets and meat buns seems like
quite a lot of food to finish...
choice_data_list: In that case, we'd better savor every bite!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Save it for later... That's a good idea! Since it's a home-cooked
meal, I must savor and treasure every bite.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Um... where might I be able to
find storage containers?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By suggesting freezing the leftovers, I managed to keep Verxina from overeating.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I need to give those kids my feedback later.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You ate... all the meat buns...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
My luqaimat too!
Yaaay, thank you so muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "And then? And then? Big sis, was it tasty?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, of course.
After all, this is a home-cooked meal made by you all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After polishing off the sweets and meat buns,
Verxina shared her thoughts with her sisters.
